import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import lightgbm as lgb
import xgboost as xgb
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import os
import re
import warnings
import gc
import time

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
start_time = time.time()

# Load Data
train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

# Preserve original Comment and Date for submission
test_comment_original = test["Comment"].copy()
test_date_original = test["Date"].copy()

# Clean Comments for training
train["Comment"] = train["Comment"].str.strip('"').str.strip()
test["Comment"] = test["Comment"].str.strip('"').str.strip()


# Create metadata features
def create_meta_features(df):
    df = df.copy()
    df["char_len"] = df["Comment"].str.len()
    df["word_count"] = df["Comment"].str.split().str.len()
    df["caps_ratio"] = df["Comment"].apply(
        lambda x: sum(1 for c in x if c.isupper()) / max(len(x), 1)
    )
    df["word_len_avg"] = df.apply(
        lambda x: x["word_count"] / max(x["char_len"], 1), axis=1
    )
    return df


train_meta = create_meta_features(train)
test_meta = create_meta_features(test)


# Create character n-grams features
char_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char", ngram_range=(2, 4), max_features=5000, dtype=np.float32
)
X_char_train = char_vectorizer.fit_transform(train_meta["Comment"])
X_char_test = char_vectorizer.transform(test_meta["Comment"])

# Create word-based TF-IDF features
word_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    ngram_range=(1, 3),
    max_features=15000,
    min_df=2,
    max_df=0.8,
    strip_accents="unicode",
    dtype=np.float32,
)
X_word_train = word_vectorizer.fit_transform(train_meta["Comment"])
X_word_test = word_vectorizer.transform(test_meta["Comment"])

# Combine text features horizontally
X_train_vec = np.hstack([X_char_train.toarray(), X_word_train.toarray()])
X_test_vec = np.hstack([X_char_test.toarray(), X_word_test.toarray()])

# Add metadata as dense float features
X_train_base = np.hstack(
    [
        train_meta[["char_len", "word_count", "caps_ratio", "word_len_avg"]].values,
        X_train_vec,
    ]
)
X_test_base = np.hstack(
    [
        test_meta[["char_len", "word_count", "caps_ratio", "word_len_avg"]].values,
        X_test_vec,
    ]
)


# Add temporal-targeting features
def count_urgency_temporal_clustering(text):
    text_lower = text.lower()
    urgency_words = [
        "now",
        "today",
        "right",
        "tonight",
        "immediately",
        "quickly",
        "just",
    ]
    negative_words = {
        "idiot",
        "stupid",
        "fool",
        "moron",
        "asshole",
        "bitch",
        "nigger",
        "faggot",
        "f**k",
        "suck",
        "fucking",
        "damn",
        "hell",
        "crap",
        "shit",
        "ugly",
        "fat",
        "worse",
        "terrible",
        "awful",
        "horrible",
        "disgusting",
        "idiotic",
        "incompetent",
        "worthless",
        "useless",
        "garbage",
        "hate",
        "hated",
        "hating",
        "hateful",
        "insult",
        "insults",
        "insulted",
        "insulting",
        "troll",
        "trolls",
        "trolling",
        "retarded",
        "disabled",
        "gay",
        "fag",
        "wanker",
        "arrogant",
    }

    words = re.findall(r"\b[a-zA-Z]+\b", text_lower)
    word_positions = {}

    for i, w in enumerate(words):
        if w in negative_words or any(nw in w for nw in negative_words):
            word_positions[i] = w

    urgency_positions = set()
    for i, w in enumerate(words):
        for urg in urgency_words:
            if urg in w:
                urgency_positions.add(i)
                break

    temporal_targeting = 0
    for neg_pos in word_positions:
        for urg_pos in urgency_positions:
            if abs(neg_pos - urg_pos) <= 5:
                temporal_targeting += 1
                break

    return temporal_targeting / max(len(words), 1)


train["temporal_urgency"] = train["Comment"].apply(count_urgency_temporal_clustering)
test["temporal_urgency"] = test["Comment"].apply(count_urgency_temporal_clustering)


# Add second-person pronoun features
def count_second_person(text):
    text_lower = text.lower()
    pronouns = ["you", "your", "yours", "yourselves"]
    return sum(text_lower.count(p) for p in pronouns)


def check_you_in_first_sentence(text):
    text_lower = text.lower()
    first_sent = text.split(".")[0].split("!", 1)[0].split("?", 1)[0].strip()
    pronouns = ["you", "your"]
    return 1 if any(p in first_sent for p in pronouns) else 0


train["you_count"] = train["Comment"].apply(count_second_person)
test["you_count"] = test["Comment"].apply(count_second_person)
train["you_ratio"] = train["you_count"] / (train["you_count"].clip(lower=1) + 1e-10)
test["you_ratio"] = test["you_count"] / (test["you_count"].clip(lower=1) + 1e-10)
train["you_in_first"] = train["Comment"].apply(check_you_in_first_sentence)
test["you_in_first"] = test["Comment"].apply(check_you_in_first_sentence)


# Add punctuation and aggression features
def count_exclamation(text):
    return text.count("!")


def count_question(text):
    return text.count("?")


def count_sentences(text):
    sentences = re.split(r"(?<=[.!?])\s+", text)
    return len([s for s in sentences if s.strip()])


def count_all_caps_words(text):
    words = text.split()
    return sum(1 for w in words if w.isupper() and len(w) > 1)


def get_exclamation_ratio(text):
    exclaim = count_exclamation(text)
    total_sent = count_sentences(text)
    return exclaim / max(total_sent, 1)


def get_question_ratio(text):
    question = count_question(text)
    total_sent = count_sentences(text)
    return question / max(total_sent, 1)


def get_all_caps_ratio(text):
    all_caps = count_all_caps_words(text)
    total_words = len(text.split())
    return all_caps / max(total_words, 1)


def has_multiple_exclamation(text):
    return 1 if text.count("!") >= 2 else 0


def has_all_caps_sentence(text):
    sentences = re.split(r"(?<=[.!?])\s+", text)
    for sent in sentences:
        words = sent.split()
        if len(words) >= 3 and all(word.isupper() for word in words if len(word) > 1):
            return 1
    return 0


train["exclamation_count"] = train["Comment"].apply(count_exclamation)
test["exclamation_count"] = test["Comment"].apply(count_exclamation)
train["question_count"] = train["Comment"].apply(count_question)
test["question_count"] = test["Comment"].apply(count_question)
train["sentence_count"] = train["Comment"].apply(count_sentences)
test["sentence_count"] = test["Comment"].apply(count_sentences)
train["exclamation_ratio"] = train["Comment"].apply(get_exclamation_ratio)
test["exclamation_ratio"] = test["Comment"].apply(get_exclamation_ratio)
train["question_ratio"] = train["Comment"].apply(get_question_ratio)
test["question_ratio"] = test["Comment"].apply(get_question_ratio)
train["all_caps_ratio"] = train["Comment"].apply(get_all_caps_ratio)
test["all_caps_ratio"] = test["Comment"].apply(get_all_caps_ratio)
train["multiple_exclamation"] = train["Comment"].apply(has_multiple_exclamation)
test["multiple_exclamation"] = test["Comment"].apply(has_multiple_exclamation)
train["all_caps_sentence"] = train["Comment"].apply(has_all_caps_sentence)
test["all_caps_sentence"] = test["Comment"].apply(has_all_caps_sentence)


# Add INTERACTION FEATURES
train["interaction_you_exclaim"] = train["you_ratio"] * train["exclamation_ratio"]
test["interaction_you_exclaim"] = test["you_ratio"] * test["exclamation_ratio"]
train["interaction_you_question"] = train["you_ratio"] * train["question_ratio"]
test["interaction_you_question"] = test["you_ratio"] * test["question_ratio"]
train["interaction_you_caps"] = train["you_ratio"] * train["all_caps_ratio"]
test["interaction_you_caps"] = test["you_ratio"] * test["all_caps_ratio"]
train["interaction_temporal_exclaim"] = (
    train["temporal_urgency"] * train["exclamation_ratio"]
)
test["interaction_temporal_exclaim"] = (
    test["temporal_urgency"] * test["exclamation_ratio"]
)
train["interaction_temporal_you"] = train["temporal_urgency"] * train["you_ratio"]
test["interaction_temporal_you"] = test["temporal_urgency"] * test["you_ratio"]


# Create sentence-level features
def extract_sentences(text):
    sentences = re.split(r"(?<=[.!?])\s+", text)
    return [s.strip() for s in sentences if s.strip()]


def count_first_sentence_negative_density(text):
    sentences = extract_sentences(text)
    if not sentences:
        return 0.0
    first_sent = sentences[0].lower()

    negative_words = {
        "idiot",
        "stupid",
        "fool",
        "moron",
        "asshole",
        "bitch",
        "hate",
        "insult",
        "insults",
        "insulted",
        "insulting",
        "troll",
        "ugly",
        "fat",
        "disgusting",
        "terrible",
        "awful",
        "worthless",
        "useless",
        "garbage",
    }

    words = re.findall(r"\b[a-zA-Z]+\b", first_sent)
    neg_count = sum(
        1
        for w in words
        if w in negative_words or any(nw in w.lower() for nw in negative_words)
    )
    return neg_count / max(len(words), 1)


def count_later_sentence_negative_density(text):
    sentences = extract_sentences(text)
    if len(sentences) <= 1:
        return 0.0

    neg_count = 0
    total_words = 0
    neg_words = {
        "idiot",
        "stupid",
        "fool",
        "moron",
        "asshole",
        "bitch",
        "hate",
        "insult",
        "insults",
        "insulted",
        "insulting",
        "troll",
        "trolls",
        "retarded",
        "ugly",
        "fat",
        "disgusting",
        "terrible",
        "awful",
        "worthless",
        "useless",
        "garbage",
    }

    for i, sent in enumerate(sentences[1:], 1):
        words = re.findall(r"\b[a-zA-Z]+\b", sent.lower())
        total_words += len(words)
        for w in words:
            if w in neg_words or any(nw in w.lower() for nw in neg_words):
                neg_count += 1

    return neg_count / max(total_words, 1)


train["first_sent_neg_density"] = train["Comment"].apply(
    count_first_sentence_negative_density
)
test["first_sent_neg_density"] = test["Comment"].apply(
    count_first_sentence_negative_density
)
train["later_sent_neg_density"] = train["Comment"].apply(
    count_later_sentence_negative_density
)
test["later_sent_neg_density"] = test["Comment"].apply(
    count_later_sentence_negative_density
)

train["first_sent_sent_count"] = train["Comment"].apply(
    lambda x: len(extract_sentences(x))
)
test["first_sent_sent_count"] = test["Comment"].apply(
    lambda x: len(extract_sentences(x))
)

train["sentence_ratio_first"] = train["first_sent_sent_count"] / train[
    "sentence_count"
].clip(lower=1)
test["sentence_ratio_first"] = test["first_sent_sent_count"] / test[
    "sentence_count"
].clip(lower=1)

train["first_sent_word_ratio"] = train.apply(
    lambda x: x["first_sent_neg_density"]
    / max(x["first_sent_neg_density"] + x["later_sent_neg_density"], 1e-10),
    axis=1,
)
test["first_sent_word_ratio"] = test.apply(
    lambda x: x["first_sent_neg_density"]
    / max(x["first_sent_neg_density"] + x["later_sent_neg_density"], 1e-10),
    axis=1,
)


# Add targeting context features
def count_targeting_negative_density(text):
    text_lower = text.lower()
    words = text_lower.split()

    pronoun_positions = set()
    for i, w in enumerate(words):
        if "you" in w or "your" in w:
            pronoun_positions.add(i)

    negative_words = {
        "idiot",
        "stupid",
        "fool",
        "moron",
        "asshole",
        "bitch",
        "hate",
        "insult",
        "insults",
        "insulted",
        "insulting",
        "troll",
        "trolls",
        "retarded",
        "ugly",
        "fat",
        "disgusting",
        "terrible",
        "awful",
        "worthless",
        "useless",
        "garbage",
    }

    targeting_count = 0
    for i, w in enumerate(words):
        if w in negative_words or any(nw in w for nw in negative_words):
            for pos in pronoun_positions:
                if abs(i - pos) <= 3:
                    targeting_count += 1
                    break

    return targeting_count / max(len(words), 1)


train["targeting_neg_density"] = train["Comment"].apply(
    count_targeting_negative_density
)
test["targeting_neg_density"] = test["Comment"].apply(count_targeting_negative_density)


# Prepare features
feature_cols_meta = ["char_len", "word_count", "caps_ratio", "word_len_avg"]
feature_cols_text = [
    "you_count",
    "you_ratio",
    "you_in_first",
    "exclamation_count",
    "question_count",
    "sentence_count",
    "exclamation_ratio",
    "question_ratio",
    "all_caps_ratio",
    "multiple_exclamation",
    "all_caps_sentence",
    "interaction_you_exclaim",
    "interaction_you_question",
    "interaction_you_caps",
    "first_sent_neg_density",
    "later_sent_neg_density",
    "first_sent_sent_count",
    "sentence_ratio_first",
    "first_sent_word_ratio",
    "targeting_neg_density",
    "temporal_urgency",
    "interaction_temporal_exclaim",
    "interaction_temporal_you",
]

X_train = np.hstack(
    [
        X_train_base,
        train_meta[feature_cols_meta].values,
        train[feature_cols_text].values,
    ]
)
X_test = np.hstack(
    [X_test_base, test_meta[feature_cols_meta].values, test[feature_cols_text].values]
)
y_train = train["Insult"].values.astype(np.float32)

# Stratified Train/Val Split for honest evaluation (80/20)
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

# ============================================
# MODEL 1: LightGBM
# ============================================
print("Training LightGBM model...")
lgb_model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
    n_estimators=500,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    num_leaves=64,
    max_depth=8,
    min_child_samples=20,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    reg_alpha=0.1,
    reg_lambda=0.1,
    random_state=42,
    verbose=-1,
    n_jobs=-1,
)
lgb_model.fit(X_tr, y_tr)
lgb_pred_proba = lgb_model.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]

# ============================================
# MODEL 2: XGBoost
# ============================================
print("Training XGBoost model...")
xgb_model = xgb.XGBClassifier(
    n_estimators=500,
    max_depth=6,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    random_state=42,
    n_jobs=-1,
    verbose=False,
)
xgb_model.fit(X_tr, y_tr)
xgb_pred_proba = xgb_model.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]

# ============================================
# MODEL 3: RandomForest (FIXED verbose parameter)
# ============================================
print("Training RandomForest model...")
rf_model = RandomForestClassifier(
    n_estimators=300,
    max_depth=10,
    min_samples_split=10,
    min_samples_leaf=5,
    max_features="sqrt",
    bootstrap=True,
    verbose=0,  # FIXED: was -1, now 0
    random_state=42,
    n_jobs=-1,
)
rf_model.fit(X_tr, y_tr)
rf_pred_proba = rf_model.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]

# ============================================
# ENSEMBLE PREDICTIONS
# ============================================
# Average predictions from all three models
ensemble_pred_proba = (
    1 / 3 * lgb_pred_proba + 1 / 3 * xgb_pred_proba + 1 / 3 * rf_pred_proba
)

# Evaluate on Validation (hold-out, never used in training)
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, ensemble_pred_proba)
print(f"LightGBM AUC-ROC: {val_auc:.6f}")
print(f"XGBoost AUC-ROC: {roc_auc_score(y_val, xgb_pred_proba):.6f}")
print(f"RandomForest AUC-ROC: {roc_auc_score(y_val, rf_pred_proba):.6f}")
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC (ensemble): {val_auc:.6f}")

# ============================================
# SAVE FINAL PREDICTIONS
# ============================================
test_pred = (
    1 / 3 * lgb_model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]
    + 1 / 3 * xgb_model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]
    + 1 / 3 * rf_model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]
)

# Prepare Submission with EXACT original Comment and Date values from test.csv
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {"Comment": test_comment_original, "Date": test_date_original, "Insult": test_pred}
)

# Verify row counts and column names match expectations
assert len(submission) == len(
    test
), f"Submission has {len(submission)} rows, test has {len(test)}"
assert list(submission.columns) == [
    "Comment",
    "Date",
    "Insult",
], "Column names must match exactly"
assert submission["Insult"].dtype in [
    np.float32,
    np.float64,
], "Insult predictions must be numeric"
assert (
    submission["Insult"].min() >= 0 and submission["Insult"].max() <= 1
), "Predictions must be in [0,1]"

# Save submission in correct location
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"Submission saved: {len(submission)} rows to ./submission/submission.csv")
print("Columns:", list(submission.columns))
print(
    f"Prediction range: [{submission['Insult'].min():.6f}, {submission['Insult'].max():.6f}]"
)
print(f"AUC-ROC on hold-out validation set (ensemble): {val_auc:.6f}")
print(f"Total runtime: {time.time() - start_time:.2f} seconds")
